source.how: The R-5 lots between Baseline Road and the Tualatin Valley Highway west of 219th Avenue (Cornelius Pass Road), which are the Reedville and Tualatin Valley Highway Corridor subareas by the text's bounds (#L821-L824, L863-L866), whose design elements 5 and 3 make development proposals 'address the city of Hillsboro's development standards' (#L854, L883). Steph 2026-10-31 (rulings.yaml 2026-10-31-east-hillsboro-city-standards-are-an-overlay): an overlay, screened against both the county zone and the Hillsboro standards, the stricter governing each check. The features and geometry are chunk 8's, unchanged; only the file they sit in moved.
